identify: Small black spots appear on the older leaves.
The spots grow and show rings like a bull's eye. The tissue around the spot may turn yellow.
damage: Much of the leaves can be killed in hot and humid weather. Spots on the stem can girdle the plant.

cultural: Collect and destroy the crop debris.
Use fertilizers in a balanced way.

safety: Spray only when the disease is seen on the crop. Wear gloves and a mask when you spray.

stage_notes.vegetative: The disease is seen mostly during tuber bulking and goes on until harvest.
